programme.desc: A twist of indie
programme.series-desc:
The story begins with Shirō Kido's reunion with a former classmate, Rio Kijima, at a college teacher's funeral. In the past, when they were students, Kijima used to show talent as a novelist, even earning a big prize. Kido was jealous of Kijima's success, but after reading his works he became aware of his lack of talent and gave up writing novels and became an editor of erotic novels.
However, after reuniting it became clear to Kido that Kijima was stuck; facing a wall. He had used up all his talent. With Kido also being in a lost state, he offers Kijima the opportunity to write pornographic novels. With the intense eroticism and closeness, both men open up and feed into their desire. As their lust grows, so does their toxic craving.
The two become a relationship beyond the line while a mixture of emotions are drawn from the suffering Kijima.

programme.title: Find My Country House: Canada
programme.desc: Couples looking to relocate from the city find their perfect country house in a regional, Canadian location.
programme.series-desc: The television series helps a couple find their perfect country house. They are looking to relocate from the city to a regional, Canadian location. programme.title: Tagata Pasifika
programme.desc: Tagata Pasifika is TVNZ's flagship Pacific news show, telling the stories of Pacific Islanders and its community. Made with the support of NZ on Air.
programme.series-desc: Tagata Pasifika is a news and current affairs show that specifically caters to New Zealand's Pacific Island community. With its own authentic voice, this show is made by Pacific people, for Pacific people.

programme.title: Songs Of Praise
programme.desc: Inspiring hymns and songs, together with uplifting stories of faith from around the UK and beyond.
programme.series-desc:
Songs of Praise is a BBC Television religious programme based around Christian hymns which began in October 1961. It is the most-watched British religious television programme.
The first edition was broadcast from the Tabernacle Baptist Church in Cardiff, and the series is the longest-running of its kind on television anywhere in the world.

programme.title: Susan Calman's Grand Day Out
programme.desc: In Kent, Susan visits Hever Castle, the childhood home of Anne Boleyn, Canterbury Cathedral, the premier place for a medieval pilgrimage, and Penshurst, where she tries her hand at fencing.
programme.series-desc: The comedian explores the British isles in her vintage camper van, Helen, taking in some dramatic scenery, unspoilt countryside and incredible historic sights along the way.

programme.title: Q+A with Jack Tame
programme.desc: Hosted by Jack Tame, Q+A brings viewers the important political interviews and discussions of the week, taking a close look at politics, economics, and global events.
programme.series-desc: Join Jack Tame and the team and find the answers to the questions that matter. Made with the support of NZ on Air.

programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: Waka Huia is an iconic archival documentary series recording the unique stories and histories of Maori for all New Zealanders.
programme.series-desc: Waka Huia is an iconic archival series recording the unique stories and histories of Māori for all New Zealanders.

programme.title: Marae
programme.desc: Your way in to the Māori world and the issues that matter. Māiatanga, Whanaungatanga, Manaakitanga - We bring you stories with heart.
programme.series-desc: Bringing Māori current affairs to the forefront, examining the issues shaping our communities and the voices behind them. Hosted by Scotty Morrison.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: It's a Bake Off first as the bakers get groovy for 1970s Week with towering profiteroles and a retro favourite. Whose gateau will steal the show, and who'll make the semi-final?
programme.series-desc: This is the ultimate baking battle, where passionate amateurs compete to be crowned Britain's best. In every episode, the judges set challenges to test a different baking skill, each becoming more difficult as the competition unfolds.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is in Puglia making Passata before discovering an ingredient popular in this Italian region, Pomegranates before cooking up delicious dishes celebrating them.
programme.series-desc: Tom Kerridge hits the road in his 1950s food truck to discover what it takes to produce the food on people's plates and to cook with the ingredients he finds along the way.

programme.title: Coastal Wonders

programme.series-desc: Cousins Mig and Scott combine top class fishing with their down to earth attitude to inject something fresh into the fishing show scene.

programme.series-desc: Answer a series of questions and walk off with a heap of cash. The only thing in these contestants' way is The Chaser, one of the finest brains in the world.

programme.series-desc: Join the 1News team as they bring you the latest news from here and overseas.

programme.desc: Takashi Sorimachi stars as Satoru Tachibana, an advertising firm employee slaving away under a younger boss for a meager salary. One day, he desperately enters a lottery, trying to make enough money to pay for his child support, but his sense of self-disgust kicks in. However, his curiosity gets the better of him, and he later discovers that the ticket is a winner, turning him into a millionaire overnight. --Tokyograph

programme.title: The Last Alaskans
programme.desc: Autumn continues in the bush as the Last Alaskans settle into wilderness solitude. Battling loneliness, Bob Harte welcomes a visitor to his cabin.
programme.series-desc: In 1980, the U.S. government banned new human occupation in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge in Alaska, a protected area, home to thousands of native animals and pristine terrain spanning roughly the size of South Carolina. Currently, only a handful of families spread across seven permitted cabins are allowed to remain in the refuge. Within less than 100 years, all remaining permits will reach expiration, and there will be no human presence left.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Mike Brewer discovers a Mini Mark 1, in Wales. Ace mechanic Marc 'Elvis' Priestley knows making radical changes to such a historic car will enrage Mini enthusiasts.
programme.series-desc: Experienced car dealer Mike Brewer is joined by multi-talented mechanics in a monumental motoring mission: to find and restore iconic cars to later sell for a profit at their LA-based shop. In the series, Mike has the challenging job of finding vehicles that have money-making potential. He then hands them over to a mechanic, who tackles everything from bare metal re-sprays to gearbox swaps to bring them back to their former glory.

programme.title: Lotto
programme.desc: Takashi Sorimachi stars as Satoru Tachibana, an advertising firm employee slaving away under a younger boss for a meager salary. programme.title: My Pregnant Husband
programme.desc: Ari, Caitlin, Myles, and Precious experience the joy of a transgender pregnancy when Ari and Myles, the men in their relationships, become pregnant. The couples must then conquer unique...
programme.series-desc: Antique restorer Sang Qian (Claire Sanders), misunderstanding that her husband Jin Changyu (Charles King) still harbors feelings for his unrequited love, files for divorce in despair. However, she unexpectedly discovers she's pregnant, but her doctor tells her she can't have an abortion due to health reasons. Jin Changyu uses this opportunity to offer two choices: cancel the divorce or get a divorce certificate, but they must live together during the pregnancy. Sang Qian, seeking freedom, chooses the latter, beginning a post-divorce "roommate" relationship. During their cohabitation, her workaholic ex-husband transforms into a clingy figure, displaying his affection. Sang Qian gradually realizes that their relationship is built on layers of misunderstanding, ultimately resolving their issues and reconciling.

programme.title: Sex Sent Me To The ER
programme.desc: A two-hour orgasm sends a woman to the ER, a couple choose an unlikely romantic spot that leads to injury, and a naked man takes a suspicious fall.
programme.series-desc: Sex in a tree? A quickie in the closet? Laundry room relations? These are just a few of the out-of-the-ordinary places where amorous adventurers go to get intimate with their other halves. But few people expect to land themselves in the emergency room as a result! Brought to life for Discovery Fit & Health by GRB Entertainment, the production company behind the hit show UNTOLD STORIES OF THE ER, this all-new series documents the real-life and often hilarious stories of what happens when a little action leads to a medical crisis. Retold by emergency room physicians and the actual couples who, in the heat of the moment, got themselves into a fix and needed a doctor to fix it, this series illustrates how loving couples cope when sex goes outrageously wrong.

programme.title: Bakers Vs. Fakers
programme.desc: The bakers have to use beans in campfire s'mores, and Lorraine Pascale, Damiano Carrara and Damaris Phillips judge the contestants on how they handle zucchini. S2 Ep2
programme.series-desc: Judges who know a thing or two about baking are put to the test deciphering the sweet creations of professionals who are competing against hobbyists.

programme.title: Baked In Vermont
programme.desc: Gesine Prado features the local maple syrup harvest in a big brunch for her husband's visiting family. S2 E3
programme.series-desc: Self-taught baker, teacher and cookbook author Gesine Prado believes anyone can bake; from sweet cakes, cookies and pies to savory meals, she shares tips that show how baking can be easy, accessible and fun.

programme.title: Kindred Spirits
programme.desc: Vivid apparitions seen by the owner and visitors at a Victorian inn in New Hampshire have the team investigating what powerful energy has awoken them.
programme.series-desc: Ghost hunters Adam Berry and Amy Bruni help real families who claim to be bedeviled by paranormal activity in their homes.

programme.title: The Dead Files
programme.desc: When an Iowa-based husband-and-wife paranormal investigation team is tormented by dark forces, they realise they're out of their depth and call on Steve and Amy for help.
programme.series-desc: Psychic medium Amy Allan and former NYPD homicide detective Steve DiSchiavi investigate locations that are reported to be haunted.

programme.title: These Woods Are Haunted
programme.desc: A supernatural forest creature stalks a young man in Colorado. Two friends are haunted by ghostly activity and demonic growls after a strange encounter in the Blue Ridge Mountains.
programme.series-desc: The true accounts of people who ventured deep into the forest only to come screaming out with stories that defy reality.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Zak and crew return to LA's Skid Row to investigate an abandoned building with dark history rivaling the Hotel Cecil. The dead and living push back.
programme.series-desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans and his crew, Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin, search for haunted locations both domestically and internationally. During their investigations, Zak and crew acquaint themselves with the general area; interview locals about the hauntings; and go face-to-face with the evil spirits who reportedly haunt these locations.

programme.title: House Hunters
programme.desc: A stay-at-home dad tries to convince his wife that they need a fixer-upper with lots of acreage.
programme.series-desc: With the help of Matt Gibb, Kiwi couples escape the rat race to look for their dream homes in regional New Zealand.

It Is Written is an internationally broadcast Christian television program founded in 1956 by George Vandeman. Its title comes from the Gospel of Matthew: "It is written, 'Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God.'" The programs are produced by the Adventist Media Center in California.

programme.series-desc: In a day when many scholars have reduced Christ to a historical or purely figurative being, this seven-part documentary series stands to affirm His divinity by reconciling the historical Christ with the Christ of religious tradition. Is He man or Son of God? Social revolutionary or the Savior? This series travels deep into the heart of the Holy Land to answer the question that religious leaders, scholars, and all mankind have been asking for centuries - Who is Jesus Christ? Follow scholars as they walk the roads He walked, examining all facets of the Savior's existence - from His premortal ministry to His death and resurrection, to the restoration of His Church and His latter-day reign. With enlightening new scholarly evidence, powerful testimony, and stunning visual effects, this seven-part documentary will help you see the Savior in a whole new light.

programme.series-desc:
Ancient Discoveries was a television series that premiered on December 21, 2003, on The History Channel. The program focused on ancient technologies. The show's theme was that many inventions which are thought to be modern have ancient roots or in some cases may have been lost and then reinvented. The program was a follow-up to a special originally broadcast in 2005 which focused on technologies from the Ancient Roman era such as the Antikythera mechanism and inventors such as Heron of Alexandria. Episodes of the regular series expanded to cover other areas such as Egypt, China and East Asia, and the Islamic world.
Ancient Discoveries was made for The History Channel by Wild Dream Films based in Cardiff in the UK. Much of the filming was done on location across the world. The series used contributions from archaeologists and other experts, footage of historical sites and artifacts, computer generated reconstructions and dramatized reconstructions along with experiments and tests on reconstructed artifacts.

programme.series-desc:
Ancient Discoveries was a television series that premiered on December 21, 2003, on The History Channel. The program focused on ancient technologies. The show's theme was that many inventions which are thought to be modern have ancient roots or in some cases may have been lost and then reinvented. The program was a follow-up to a special originally broadcast in 2005 which focused on technologies from the Ancient Roman era such as the Antikythera mechanism and inventors such as Heron of Alexandria. Episodes of the regular series expanded to cover other areas such as Egypt, China and East Asia, and the Islamic world.
Ancient Discoveries was made for The History Channel by Wild Dream Films based in Cardiff in the UK. Much of the filming was done on location across the world. The series used contributions from archaeologists and other experts, footage of historical sites and artifacts, computer generated reconstructions and dramatized reconstructions along with experiments and tests on reconstructed artifacts.

programme.series-desc:
Ancient Discoveries was a television series that premiered on December 21, 2003, on The History Channel. The program focused on ancient technologies. The show's theme was that many inventions which are thought to be modern have ancient roots or in some cases may have been lost and then reinvented. The program was a follow-up to a special originally broadcast in 2005 which focused on technologies from the Ancient Roman era such as the Antikythera mechanism and inventors such as Heron of Alexandria. Episodes of the regular series expanded to cover other areas such as Egypt, China and East Asia, and the Islamic world.
Ancient Discoveries was made for The History Channel by Wild Dream Films based in Cardiff in the UK. Much of the filming was done on location across the world. The series used contributions from archaeologists and other experts, footage of historical sites and artifacts, computer generated reconstructions and dramatized reconstructions along with experiments and tests on reconstructed artifacts.

programme.series-desc: The year is 1899. The young girl Marie Jensen lives at an orphanage with her two younger siblings Karl and Sofie. Their father is a sailor and has not been home for years. He was last seen in Norway but everybody is convinced he was lost at sea – except Marie. One morning the beautiful freighter ‘Hope’ comes to town with Skipper Andersen and his wife Mrs. Agnete on board. To Marie’s distress, they adopt Karl and Sofie, and Marie now faces being left alone. But quickly she comes up with a plan. At night, she cuts her long hair and disguises herself as a boy, adopts the name of Martin and signs on as a deck boy on ‘’Hope’. The ship takes Marie and her siblings on an eventful journey from the coast of Denmark to Norway and Iceland. A journey full of secrets, friendship, love and adventure – all in the hope of finding her father and reuniting her family. 'Finding Home' is a story about a young girl’s fight to break free of the path that society has destined for her and instead becoming a strong and independent woman.

programme.series-desc: The year is 1899. The young girl Marie Jensen lives at an orphanage with her two younger siblings Karl and Sofie. Their father is a sailor and has not been home for years. He was last seen in Norway but everybody is convinced he was lost at sea – except Marie. One morning the beautiful freighter ‘Hope’ comes to town with Skipper Andersen and his wife Mrs. Agnete on board. To Marie’s distress, they adopt Karl and Sofie, and Marie now faces being left alone. But quickly she comes up with a plan. At night, she cuts her long hair and disguises herself as a boy, adopts the name of Martin and signs on as a deck boy on ‘’Hope’. The ship takes Marie and her siblings on an eventful journey from the coast of Denmark to Norway and Iceland. A journey full of secrets, friendship, love and adventure – all in the hope of finding her father and reuniting her family. 'Finding Home' is a story about a young girl’s fight to break free of the path that society has destined for her and instead becoming a strong and independent woman.

programme.series-desc: The year is 1899. The young girl Marie Jensen lives at an orphanage with her two younger siblings Karl and Sofie. Their father is a sailor and has not been home for years. He was last seen in Norway but everybody is convinced he was lost at sea – except Marie. One morning the beautiful freighter ‘Hope’ comes to town with Skipper Andersen and his wife Mrs. Agnete on board. To Marie’s distress, they adopt Karl and Sofie, and Marie now faces being left alone. But quickly she comes up with a plan. At night, she cuts her long hair and disguises herself as a boy, adopts the name of Martin and signs on as a deck boy on ‘’Hope’. The ship takes Marie and her siblings on an eventful journey from the coast of Denmark to Norway and Iceland. A journey full of secrets, friendship, love and adventure – all in the hope of finding her father and reuniting her family. 'Finding Home' is a story about a young girl’s fight to break free of the path that society has destined for her and instead becoming a strong and independent woman.

programme.desc: On July 17 2007, TAM Airlines Flight 3054 slid off runway 35L at Congonhas Airport, Sao Paulo, and crashed at high speed into a warehouse adjacent to a filling station and exploded. A total of 199 people aboard the plane and on the ground were killed. Aviation and engineering experts investigate to uncover what went wrong to cause such a catastrophe.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigations
programme.desc: On 16 August 2005, West Caribbean Airways Flight 708 flew through a thunderstorm. Shortly after, the pilots reported that both engines had failed and a few minutes later the plane crashed into a cattle farm in Venezuela, killing all 152 passengers and eight crew on board. Aviation engineers and experts investigated and made the shocking discovery that there were no faults with the engines and pilot error was solely to blame for this tragedy. What mistakes were made by the pilots that ultimately led to this catastrophe?
programme.sub-title: The Plane That Flew Too High

programme.title: Air Crash Investigations
programme.desc: On 12 December 1985, a charter flight carrying the 101st Airborne Division on Arrow Air Flight 1285, stalled and crashed just seconds after taking off from Gander International Airport in Canada while en route to Fort Campbell, Kentucky. All 256 people aboard the aircraft died. Terrorists initially claimed responsibility for the crash, but the Canadian Aviation Safety Board found that this wasn't the case, and continued their investigation until they found what caused this catastrophe.
